## Verdict — **GREEN: `protect.sh --apply all` exit 0; `--verify` prints `11 OK, 0 DRIFT`; all five mutation groups hold; `D-P34.3-1` DONE**

All three landed fixes held under live load: `window-guard` passed
under the `bb302c6f` terminal semantics; `_assert_sql_flags` read all
five flags cleanly off the ~48 KB help text (`baa46f87`); and the two
`f027c027` halves proved out end-to-end — the six `qa-6` checks now
read the applied `versioning_enabled`/`lifecycle_config` fields (10 of
11 baseline checks legible for the first time), and the cache-busted
direct-bucket probe returned a real **403** seconds after the removal
instead of attempt 3's cached 200 — no rollback ran.

```

pre-state: 7 sha256'd JSONs -> protect/pre-20261124T222118Z
backup: ON_DEMAND 1795558884162 SUCCESSFUL (op c36d3dbf-…-32, 22:21:24→22:22:55Z)

     (policy prints objectViewer = sig-web-rt only) → post site checks
     green both origins → cache-busted direct URL -> 403 → exit 0
post-state: protect/post-20261124T222311Z
in-apply verify + standalone --verify: 11 OK, 0 DRIFT (result=ok, exit 0)
```

`D-P34.3-1` is **closed**: transition event `D-P34.3-1:e1`
(`OPEN → DONE`, observed 2026-11-24) is appended to
`docs/build/reports/obligations/events.jsonl` in this leg's commit and
